profit_quality.assessment: 主业有会计利润，但 2025 年利润现金化很差。三年税后利润中位数为 RMB35.728m；2025 年经营现金流为 -RMB10.798m，且应收/票据及其他应收增加 RMB71.567m。主口径用三年利润中位数作折前分母，并按 0.35 折为可持续可分配现金利润。
adjustments: 2025 reported profit RMB57.040m contains RMB8.743m reversal of receivable impairment losses and RMB1.962m government grants.
2025 operating cash flow was negative despite reported profit, mainly because receivables increased materially.
PPE note records RMB23.669m construction-in-progress additions, but cash flow statement does not separately show 2025 cash capex, so maintenance capex cannot be precisely split.
No dividend was recommended for 2025, so reported profit is not being demonstrated as distributable cash to shareholders.
profit_quality.cashflow_support: 2025 OCF / profit = -18.9%; 2024 OCF was RMB12.211m against profit RMB21.141m; 2023 OCF from prior-year comparator was negative. Cash conversion is volatile and weak.
profit_quality.haircut_reason: 应收占用和减值转回显示利润质量不足；制造业仍有真实毛利和多年盈利记录，因此不置空，但将利润现金化折为 35%。
profit_quality.cash_conversion_assessment: Weak; 2025 profit mostly did not convert into operating cash.
profit_quality.maintenance_capex_assessment: Unclear; 2025 PPE additions exist but cash capex line is absent, so handled through profit haircut rather than separate capex deduction.
profit_quality.working_capital_assessment: High reinvestment/collection pressure: trade, bill and other receivables increased RMB71.567m in 2025.
